cards.title: Pro Rank

ability.name: Starter perks
ability.text: Lobby particle ×1, [Pro] chat prefix, early 5th MineMart slot.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft Java store tile: lime-green emerald rank medallion on a mossy oak podium, modest rank hall, single green firework spark, iron armor stand, warm lantern light, no text, no UI.

cards.title: Ace Rank

ability.name: Best deal
ability.text: Two lobby particles, [Ace] prefix, 100 bonus Victory Coins, extra ranked maps.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft Java store tile: golden ace-of-spades medallion made of gold blocks, two gold particle spirals, enchanted golden armor on a stand, purple wool banners, ceremonial hall, no text, no UI.

cards.title: Legend Rank

ability.name: Top tier
ability.text: Three particles, [Legend] prefix, 1000 bonus coins, most ranked maps.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft Java store tile: blazing orange netherite crown on a quartz and gold throne, three flame particles, netherite armor with orange trim, lava glow, legendary hall, no text, no UI.

cards.title: Victory Coins

ability.name: Server currency
ability.text: Spend on kits, extra inventory, and lobby cosmetics. Also earned by playing.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft Java store tile: overflowing brown leather coin pouch spilling gold nugget coins beside an open chest in a vault, warm torch light, no readable text, no UI.

cards.title: Survive Disasters

ability.name: Disaster rounds
ability.text: Survive shifting hazards. Ranked maps can appear when a ranked player is in the game.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft Java store tile of a Survive Disasters kit: open chest with iron sword, water bucket, cobblestone, and shield, meteor raining on a cracked stone arena behind, no text, no UI.

cards.title: MineMart

ability.name: Infinite store
ability.text: Shop-crawl minigame. Ranks unlock the 5th inventory slot early.

cards.image_prompt: Minecraft Java store tile of a MineMart shopping kit: iron-bar shopping cart packed with food and tools, item-frame supermarket aisles stretching forever, bright redstone lamps, no text, no UI.
